title: Ogre celebrate U19 League title
description: FINALRiga/DSN - Ogre 70-76 Ogre had a 37-24 advantage in offensive rebounds. Worth to mention a great performance of guard Davids Mals (187-2004) who helped to win the game recording 25 points and 6 rebounds. Markuss Lastis contributed with 16 points and 5 rebounds for the winners. Forward Rolands Dizgalvis (198-2003) answered with a double-double by scoring 16 points and 11 rebounds and guard Juris Vitols (187-2005) added 12 points, 9 rebounds, 4 assists and 7 steals in the effort for Riga/DSN. Four Riga/DSN players scored in double figures. Both coaches used bench players which allowed the starters a little rest for the next games.
